name: Skip or win battles
author: celophi
description: Skip fights or win them as soon as they start. Choose which in the game's menu (F1).

options.name: Regular fights
options.description: The fights that start when you walk into monsters.

choices.name: Skip them
choices.description: They don't start, so there's no experience or drops from them. Fights the story starts still happen.

choices.name: Win them instantly
choices.description: They're won as soon as they start, drops and experience included, with no results window.

options.name: Boss fights
options.description: Fights with a boss in them. They can't be skipped, since the story needs them won.

choices.name: Win them instantly
choices.description: They're won as soon as they start, and the story goes on as if you'd beaten them, with no results window.
